Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
MOEV-0000 Add frame analysis overlay feature

Implemented frame-level video segment analysis using mp4box.js:

- Added FrameAnalyzerService to parse MP4/fMP4 segments and extract frame metadata
- Created FrameOverlayComponent with visual timeline showing I-frames vs P/B-frames
- Added toggle button in icon-bar to show/hide frame overlay
- Displays frame statistics: total frames, keyframes, GOP size, duration
- Shows detailed frame table with PTS, DTS, size, and type
- Integrated into manifest-viewer component
- Added showFrameOverlay flag to ViewerState and ViewerOptionTypes

Key features:
- Visual frame timeline with color-coded bars \(green=I-frames, gray=P/B-frames\)
- Supports MP4/fMP4 segments \(DASH streams\)
- Error handling for fetch failures and unsupported formats
- MPEG-TS support planned for future iteration

Dependencies:
- Added mp4box package for segment parsing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
